identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.100: pick the vehicle type (car, bicycle, motorcycle) at the top of the dealer list; aircraft get their own gauge (throttle and altimeter) and map icon, and are never kept in the ordinary garages nor sold at the dealers: the airfield comes with the aircraft resource (rco-pioneer) and shows only while it runs, where a player with no aircraft buys one and an owner keeps it; unflipping a car picks up where it stopped if the player is knocked over.
